notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000886982-26-000091, filed February 25, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-117433, filed March 20, 2026). LLOYD BLANKFEIN (former CEO) does not appear anywhere in the 2026 proxy, including its beneficial-ownership table, so status is no-reported-stake. HOLDERS: percentages are as the proxy states them (as of March 2, 2026), derived from each holder's Schedule 13G filings; the share counts are unchanged from the 2025 proxy and rest on amendments filed in early 2024, so only the percentages moved, because Goldman's share count fell. asOf is the date of the latest amendment the proxy cites (the filing date, not the event date). DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow statement reports a single line covering common stock, preferred stock and dividend equivalents on share-based awards ($5,277 million), and the 10-K gives no separate cash-paid figure for common only, so the combined figure is used; preferred stock dividends in the income statement were $876 million. BUYBACKS: common stock only ($12,360 million); the $2,156 million of share-based awards settled to satisfy withholding tax are excluded. STOCK COMP: $3,624 million is the share-based compensation in Note 29; the cash-flow non-cash adjustment is $3,445 million (XBRL ShareBasedCompensation); the Note 29 figure is not tagged with a standard XBRL concept, so no xbrl object is given. GEOGRAPHY: the note says substantially all Americas amounts are attributable to the U.S. and Asia includes Australia and New Zealand. The 10-K mentions no employee stock purchase plan, so plan is null.
